Name: Wonder Skin
Effect: Reduce up to 2 Chance Dice from Effects of Moves or Abilities that Target this Pokémon. (Example: the Move Ember has 1 Chance Die to inflict Burn (1) on the Target; against this Pokémon it has zero Chance Dice.)
Description: The skin of this Pokémon is covered by a thin protective veil that allows it to weaken dangerous hazards.
